object_description: compact and transparent rectangular volume with slightly distorted edges, parallel to the street
geometry_property: inner courtyard on the upper floors
design_condition: the compact volume is set parallel to the street, its slight distortions of the basic rectangle making subtle references to the underpass and access area while blurring the boundaries

positive: An astonishingly compact and transparent volume oriented parallel to the street
Slight distortions of the rectangle establish subtle references to the surrounding urban context
Blurring the boundaries emphasises the transitions, the in-between and what connects
The building conveys a clear message of an open and transparent institution looking to the future
Soft boundaries, pronounced lightness and reduced volume fit the delicate urban environment
The audience-oriented uses are correctly arranged and benefit from generous outdoor spaces
The building will contribute to urban life on a functional and social level
The relatively small volume is surrounded by a generous, differentiated open space
The project reacts very differently to the different urban situations through the open space design
The deep respectful distance to the opposite row creates a wide space for arrivals and restaurants
The greened hillside character is continued on the other side
The delivery ramp was well integrated into the volume on the east side
The additional floor keeps the relatively small footprint while increasing floor area
Teaching and research are brought together on the individual floors, enabling the desired synergies
Spacious open spaces along the facade with a view of the city are created on each floor
They are invitingly connected by a staged, curved staircase
The new inner courtyard enables natural lighting and ventilation of the adjoining teaching rooms
The generous column grid and connected areas enable the desired high flexibility of use
The wide-span structure promises great flexibility of use
The architecture speaks of transparency, openness and communication
Soft boundaries and created depth let the building enter into dialogue with the city
The interiors gained quality through further development of materials and a high proportion of wood
Further development and optimisation within the proposed spatial structure can easily be implemented
The expected construction costs are within the specifications
negative: The additional floor slightly exceeds the maximum permitted height
The project lost some of its radical lightness and transparency during the cleanup stage
The roof area will hardly be usable due to the photovoltaic systems
Dispensing with the external access layer loses the clear typological structure
The proposed size of the inner courtyard is questionable
The hybrid support structure seems somewhat sought-after
The project lost sharpness and conciseness in its architectural expression
The strong horizontal parapet structure and the loss of the two-storey facade are regretted
Not all usage arrangements and processes work smoothly
Sustainability and building technology need further optimisation for certification
The usage density is significantly too high across the entire building
Almost complete glazing contradicts the basic idea of sustainability and the programme specifications
